pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

4. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

6. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Handball.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

12. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Red, blue, and yellow

9. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. D — The speed of the music

11. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descant Recorder; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Storytelling and Animation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Football; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
